provenance.paper_title: FinAcumen: Financial Multimodal Reasoning via Self-Evolving Experience Memory Harness

representation_paths.memory_component: Financial Memory (FM) bank of distilled Findings and Cautions entries harvested from multimodal financial reasoning trajectories

evidence.section: Full paper: Sec. 3 (framework), Sec. 4.1-4.2 (memory construction and selective retrieval), Appendix B (Algorithm 1)
evidence.paraphrase: Each FM entry holds the original question, the gold answer, distilled 'Findings' (successful patterns) and 'Cautions' (failure-derived guard rules), plus a pre-computed text embedding. Entries are produced by a summary agent that scores and summarises sampled trajectories over chart/table/text financial problems (Eq. 2). Retrieval embeds the incoming query with the shared encoder, keeps entries whose cosine similarity exceeds tau = 0.65 (Eq. 3-4), then deduplicates and injects the top-k into the prompt. No chart image or table artifact is stored in the entry, so the visual source is not recoverable from memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review: despite the title's 'Self-Evolving', the paper states that at test time the memory bank M* is frozen and read-only (Sec. 3, Sec. 4.1); experience accumulation happens in a separate offline phase over training trajectories, and the retrieval policy (threshold tau = 0.65, depth k_max) is static during deployment. There is no inference-time write, edit, eviction or reorganisation, so tier is T1, not T2 or T3. Figure 3's monotonic saturation at ~1800 entries is consistent with a fixed offline bank.

Scope rationale: the memory bank itself is textual (question text, gold answer, findings, cautions and text embeddings), but its entries are distilled from trajectories over chart, figure and table questions solved with a visual-decoding tool, and the retrieved memory conditions a frozen 8B VLM reasoning over chart images downstream. This satisfies criterion (b), which requires non-text participation in memory formation or downstream use rather than storage of the source artifact itself, and follows the corpus treatment of comparable text-record memories with source_accessibility 'none'.

primary_modality is image because financial charts and figures in FinMMR, FinMME and FinTMMBench provide the operative non-text evaluation setting. No new benchmark is introduced; Sec. 5.1 and Table 6 use BizBench SEC-NUM, FinMMR, FinTMMBench and FinMME.
